name: Adaptive SVD Attention — Production-Hardened (v2).
description: Adaptive SVD Attention — Production-Hardened (v2).  Low-rank factorized attention with dynamic cumulative energy-thresholded SVD and trainable residual adapters:      W ≈ U_r V_r + W_lora_B · W_lora_A     where  U_r = U_{:, :r} · √Σ_r,  V_r = √Σ_r · V^T_{:r, :}     and    r = argmin_{r} [ Σ_{i=1}^r σ_i² / Σ_j σ_j² ≥ τ ]  Fixes (v2):   ASVD-FIX-01  **`--rank` now reaches the layer.** Previous prior
math_latex: W = U \Sigma V^\top = \sum_{i=1}^{\min(d_{\text{out}}, d_{\text{in}})} \sigma_i u_i v_i^\top

components.name: Factor U (Full-Rank Expansion Projection)
components.math_latex: y_t = z_t (\Sigma_r U_r^\top) + b, \quad U_r \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}

components.name: Residual LoRA / Norm Calibration
components.math_latex: \Delta y_t = x_t (B A)^\top \cdot \frac{\alpha}{r}, \quad A \in \mathbb{R}^{r \times d_{in}}, \; B \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}
